name: Notes
description: Somewhere to put a thought before it goes. The box at the top is always open and always ready, so capturing something takes one keystroke and no decisions — no title, no folder, no file. Notes stack up newest first, grouped under the day they were written, and any word you start with a # becomes a tag you can filter by later. Space editors write and edit; everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, reads the same stream live. Deliberately not the Document frame: that one is for a page you sit down to write, this one is for the thing you would otherwise text yourself. Notes live in an encrypted LocalTable scoped to the placement.
